summary.result: Two-way fixed-effects regressions showed that planting-date dispersion was positively associated with yield, and that this association was stronger under wetter late-season conditions.
summary.background: Abstract Planting date is an important determinant of wet-season rice performance in monsoon Asia.
summary.method: Planting dates at 1 km resolution for 2002–2023 were estimated from time series of the Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) derived from the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) using the PhenoRice algorithm, and province-year indicators of mean planting date and within-province spatial standard deviation were derived.

summary_ko.result: 이중 고정효과 회귀 분석 결과, 식재 일자 확산은 수확량과 긍정적으로 연관되었으며, 특히 늦은 계절에 더 많은 강수량 조건에서는 이러한 연관성이 더 강하였다.
